description: SBI VC Trade has introduced a lending service for its yen-backed stablecoin, JPYSC, offering an initial annualised yield of 3 percent for a 12-week lending period. The initiative expands the utility of the regulated stablecoin beyond payments and into yield generation. While SBI says the returns exceed those of traditional savings accounts, the company has cautioned that the product is not a bank deposit and carries investment risks.
title: Japan’s SBI VC Trade Expands Stablecoin Services With 3 Percent Lending Yield

description: The UK could add as much as £33 billion ($44 billion) to its annual economic output by 2035 by becoming a global leader in tokenised financial markets, according to a government-backed report. The roadmap recommends issuing the country’s first tokenised government bond by early 2027 and moving beyond blockchain pilot projects into live trading. The initiative brings together major banks, crypto firms, and financial market infrastructure providers.
title: UK Tokenisation Drive May Boost Annual Output by $44 Billion: Report

description: Redmi Note 17 series has been launched. The lineup includes the two handsets, namely the Redmi Note 17 and the Note 17 Pro. The standard model succeeds the Redmi Note 15, which was recently launched in India. The handset is currently on sale in the country via the Xiaomi China online store in Black, Light Water Green, and Meteor Purple (translated from Chinese) colour options. The handset sports a 7-inch Full-HD+ (1,080 x 2,396 pixels) OLED display, offering up to 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by an octa core Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset.
title: Redmi Note 17 Launched With 8,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Huawei has introduced the Pura 90s Pro and Pura 90s Pro Max globally at an event in Malaysia. Both smartphones feature the Kirin 9030S chipset, LTPO OLED displays, EMUI 16 and 6,000mAh batteries. The Pro model supports 66W wired charging, while the Pro Max offers 100W wired charging and a 200-megapixel telephoto camera. The smartphones also include Celia AI features, IP68 and IP69 ratings, and are currently available for pre-order in Malaysia ahead of a wider global rollout.
title: Huawei Pura 90s Pro, Pura 90s Pro Max Launched With Kirin 9030S Chip, 6,000mAh Batteries: Price, Features

description: Samsung is gearing up to unveil its next-generation flagship Galaxy foldables later this month. Alongside, the South Korean tech conglomerate is also expected to introduce its flagship smartwatches, widely known as the Galaxy Watch 9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2. Ahead of their anticipated debut at Galaxy Unpacked, the company has begun teasing the new features on its upcoming Galaxy watches.
title: Samsung Touts AI-Powered Health Tracking, Longer Battery Life on Next Galaxy Watch Models

description: Realme C100x is confirmed to launch in India on July 16. The official teasers show the phone in Deepblue Tides and Golden Coast colour options. It is confirmed to come with an 8,000mAh battery. It is set to come with an IP64-rated build. It will have a 120Hz refresh rate display and a 50-megapixel AI-backed rear camera setup.
title: Realme C100x India Launch Date Announced; Leaked Image of Retail Box Hints at Price in India

description: Acer Aspire 3 (2026) has been launched in India as the latest addition to the company’s budget laptop lineup. Positioned as a laptop for students, the Acer Aspire 3 (2026) is currently available in India in two display sizes, 15.6-inch and 11.6-inch. The laptop is powered by a dual core Intel Celeron N4500 processor, paired with 8GB of LPDDR4x RAM and up to a 1TB SSD for onboard storage. It also features an Intel Graphics UHD GPU. The 15.6-inch model sports an HD (1,366 x 768 pixels) TFT LCD screen. The laptop weighs about 1.5kg.
title: Acer Aspire 3 (2026) Launched in India With Up to 15.6-Inch Display, Intel Celeron N4500 Processor: Price, Features

description: iQOO could significantly increase battery capacities across its upcoming flagship smartphones, according to a new leak. The tipster claims an engineering prototype powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset is testing an 8,500mAh battery with 100W fast charging and wireless charging. The leak also mentions 3nm performance models with 9,000mAh and 10,000mAh batteries. Earlier reports link these devices to the rumoured iQOO 16, iQOO Neo 12 and iQOO Z12 Turbo.
title: iQOO 16, Neo 12 and Z12 Turbo to Arrive With Notable Battery Upgrades, Tipster Claims

description: Honor's Robot Phone has surfaced in a fresh leak that reveals key hardware details ahead of its expected launch. A tipster  claims the handset could feature a 6.3-inch to 6.4-inch 1.5K display, Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and a triple rear camera system led by two 200-megapixel sensors. The smartphone is also tipped to use Arri Imaging technology and may introduce imaging features expected to appear later on the upcoming Magic 9 series.
title: Honor Robot Phone Leak Reveals Key Specifications Ahead of Long-Awaited Debut

description: Meta has removed the Muse Image feature, less than a week after the functionality was launched globally. The Mark Zuckerberg-led tech giant recently updated the Muse Image blog post to announce that the functionality is “no longer available”. The company said that the decision was taken because of the “feedback” it received regarding the Muse Image feature on Instagram, saying that the feature “missed the mark”. Meta said, “Our intent was to provide a useful creative tool and to give people control over whether their public content could be referenced in this way.”
title: Meta Pulls Muse AI Image Feature Less Than a Week After User Backlash Highlights Privacy Risks

description: HMD Asha 505 could launch soon, as a leak has revealed its design and key specifications. It is said to come with an 8-megapixel rear camera, a 5-megapixel front-facing camera, 4GB of RAM, 64GB of onboard storage, and a 3,000mAh battery. The render shows the phone in three colour options, and it resembles the design of Nokia Lumia 830.
title: HMD Asha 505 Surfaces Online With Lumia-Inspired Design, 5-Inch Display in New Leaked Renders

description: The HP OmniBook X 14 is a polished, focus-driven ultrabook that gets almost all the core fundamentals right. At roughly Rs. 1.7 lakh, however, the pricing certainly places it among serious competition. Even so, there’s not much to complain about. So, if you are in the market for a highly reliable, premium ultrabook that balances a premium build with a gorgeous screen and solid battery life, the HP OmniBook X 14 makes a compelling case.
title: HP OmniBook X 14 (2026) Review: Can This Finally Make You Ditch Your MacBook?

description: Redmi has launched the Note 17 Pro in China with Qualcomm's Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 chipset and a 9,000mAh battery supporting 67W fast charging. The smartphone features a 6.83-inch 1.5K 120Hz AMOLED display, up to 12GB of RAM, up to 512GB of storage and Xiaomi HyperOS 3 based on Android 16. It also offers IP66, IP68, IP69 and IP69K ratings, a 50-megapixel primary camera, 22.5W reverse charging and a battery support programme for eligible buyers.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Launched With Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 and 9,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Google Pixel 11 series smartphones carrying the model numbers G4HCD, GUJ0N, G7SWN, GBC0H, and GPQQ7 have been spotted on the FCC database. The listing suggests that they will come with a MediaTek modem. The listing shows them with 5G, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi 6 or newer connectivity options. They have wireless charging and satellite connectivity for off-grid messaging.
title: Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL Visit the US FCC Database a Month Ahead of Their Debut

description: Microsoft announced the rollout of a redesigned Windows Search experience on Monday. As per the company, it aims to make Search faster, less cluttered, and easier to use. Available to Windows Insiders in the Experimental Channel, the update removes promotional content from web search results, while also simplifying the home interface and improving result ranking. Microsoft says the changes are based on user feedback and are being rolled out gradually through Controlled Feature Rollout (CFR).
title: Microsoft Finally Gives Windows 11 Search a Major Cleanup; Promises Better App Discovery, Less Cluttered UI

description: Apple reportedly claims that OpenAI asked former Apple employees and even prospective hires to share confidential details about unreleased products. Apple also claims the company advised recruits on how to avoid its internal security procedures, using a checklist developed by Apple's former iPhone design chief. The lawsuit further alleges that OpenAI now employs more than 400 former Apple workers, attracting many with huge compensation packages.
title: Apple’s Lawsuit Claims OpenAI Hired Over 400 Former Employees, Could Disrupt AI Firm's Plans to Launch Consumer Hardware

description: Nvidia has launched the GeForce Now cloud gaming service in India. The Geforce Now cloud gaming service from Nvidia brings two subscription tiers, which will be available for all users starting July 15 (Wednesday), 7:30 am IST. The Performance plan costs Rs. 999 per month, while the Ultimate tier is priced at Rs. 1,999 per month. Users will also be able to get Day Passes at Rs. 399 and Rs. 799, respectively. The Performance plan will offer support for up to 1440p/60 fps cloud gaming, 6-hour gaming sessions, and priority access, with a typical waiting time of less than a minute. Meanwhile, the top-of-the-line Ultimate plan will let users play games at up to 5K/360 fps, while offering first priority access and 8-hour-long gaming sessions.
title: Nvidia's GeForce Now Cloud Gaming Service Launched in India With Up to 5K Gaming Support: Prices, Benefits

description: WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users, according to WABetaInfo. The feature was spotted in the latest WhatsApp beta for iOS and is expected to let users store chat backups on WhatsApp's servers instead of iCloud. The service could include 2GB of free storage with end-to-end encryption enabled by default. WhatsApp is also said to be testing paid storage plans, while a similar first-party backup service remains in development for Android users.
title: WhatsApp Might Soon Let iPhone Users Back Up Chats Without Using iCloud Storage

description: Bitcoin traded near $62,500 on Tuesday as investors awaited the US CPI report while monitoring rising Middle East tensions. Analysts said macroeconomic data and geopolitical developments are likely to determine whether Bitcoin resumes its recovery or revisits key support levels.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $62,500 as Crypto Investors Remain Cautious Ahead of US Inflation Data

description: Nothing Phone (4b) is now available for purchase in India via Flipkart. The tech firm is offering an instant discount of 7.5 percent with Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank credit cards, along with an exchange bonus. Customers can also avail up to 9 months of interest-free EMI options. The Nothing Phone (4b) is available in Black, Blue, and White colour options. Qualcomm’s 4nm octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset powers the Nothing Phone (4b), along with an Adreno 810 GPU. It also packs a 6,000mAh battery.
title: Nothing Phone (4b) With 6,000mAh Battery, Glyph Bar Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Apple is rolling out the iOS 27 Public Beta update for iPhone. First previewed at WWDC 2026 in May, the company introduced a developer beta of the latest iPhone operating system last month. However, it was only available to registered Apple developers and beta testers. It brings improvements to Liquid Glass, a smarter Siri, new features in Photos and Mail apps, and more. Alongside, Apple has also released similar public beta updates of iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, and more.
title: iOS 27 Public Beta Now Available for Eligible iPhone Models With Siri AI, Liquid Glass Upgrades: How to Install

description: AI could become “radically” more powerful over the next 10 years, according to a letter titled “We Must Act Now”, which has been signed by more than 200 economists, Nobel laureates, and industry leaders. This phenomenon is said to transform world economies in an unprecedented manner, touted to be larger than the Industrial Revolution. However, this change is predicted to unfold over a significantly shorter period of time. This rapid transformation poses significant risks, the statement notes. Among other risks, AI’s unprecedented transformation of economies is said to cause “large-scale job displacements”.
title: AI Could Drive Mass Job Displacement and Transform Economies, Economists and 16 Nobel Laureates Warn

description: Redmi 17C 5G has appeared on Geekbench, revealing key details ahead of its expected launch. The listing suggests the smartphone shares the Tornado codename with the Redmi 15C 5G and Poco C85 5G, indicating it could be a rebadged Redmi 15C 5G. It also confirms a Dimensity 6300 SoC, 4GB RAM and Android 16. Earlier reports point to a 6.9-inch HD LCD screen, 50-megapixel rear camera, 6,000mAh battery and a possible launch in global markets and India.
title: Redmi 17C 5G Visits Geekbench With What Appears to Be the Same Hardware as the Redmi 15C 5G

description: OnePlus is expected to announce its complete withdrawal from the US and European markets this week. Signs of a possible pullback have been in the news for some time.  Oppo is likely to take up a larger role in European markets. The company is likely to continue providing support for its existing customers in the US and Europe. Devices available in the market are expected to receive software updates and after-sales services throughout their promised lifespan.
title: OnePlus Reportedly Preparing to Exit US, European Markets; Operations in India Expected to Continue

description: The global smartphone shipments fell by 4 percent in the second quarter of 2026, according to the latest research report by Omdia. The report highlights that the ongoing memory and storage components shortage disrupted supply chains and drove their prices. Despite the RAM shortage, Samsung and Apple registered market share growth of 2 percent and 4 percent, respectively. Samsung retained its top position with a 22 percent market share, while Apple took the second spot with a 20 percent market share. Unlike Samsung and Apple, the handset makers, including Xiaomi, Oppo, and Vivo, reportedly witnessed a decline in their market share.
title: Samsung Retains Top Spot as Global Phone Shipments Declined in Q2 2026, iPhone Shipments Grew 4 Percent: Omdia

description: Halo Studios has reportedly cancelled a multiplayer Halo game, codenamed Project Ekur, which was initially prototyped by Certain Affinity. The game is now reportedly no longer in development. Halo Studios will release Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remake of Halo: Combat Evolved, this month.
title: Halo Studios Reportedly Cancels Halo Multiplayer Game, Codenamed 'Project Ekur'

description: Oppo's latest Find X10 Pro Max engineering prototype is still testing a triple 200-megapixel rear camera setup, according to a tipster. The leak suggests the company is aiming to retain the configuration for the production model, although the hardware is yet to be finalised. The smartphone is also tipped to launch between September and October with an updated design. Earlier reports suggest it could feature a Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, a 6.89-inch 2K LTPO OLED display and ColorOS 17.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Tipped to Launch With Three 200-Megapixel Rear Cameras

description: China-based artificial intelligence (AI) company StepFun unveiled the StepX Neo as the world's first mass-market agentic smartphone on Monday. The firm, which was founded by former Microsoft executives in 2023, claims that its first consumer hardware product features an integrated AI agent that can complete complex, multi-step tasks across apps with minimal user intervention. The handset is powered by its in-house Step Edge foundation model and runs on the company's custom Step AOS operating system.
title: StepFun Unveils StepX Neo as World's First Agentic Smartphone With Offline AI Assistant

description: iQOO 16 has been rumoured to be in development as the successor to the iQOO 15 for some time now. While the company has yet to confirm the purported handset, a tipster has leaked key details of the flagship. It is said to come equipped with flagship-grade symmetrical stereo speakers, a dedicated graphics chip, an X-axis linear motor, and a 3D ultrasonic fingerprint sensor. The tipster also reaffirmed previous reports, which claimed that the iQOO 16 could pack a battery with a capacity exceeding the 8,000mAh mark.
title: iQOO 16 Tipped to Get Flagship Dual Speakers, Dedicated Graphics Chip, and 8,500mAh Battery
